name: storm_breaker_v22
cad_source: mechanical/assemblies/full_robot/v22 (STEP frame +y forward, +x right; robot frame here x forward, y left)

intake.source: v22 CAD: INT_ parts span y_left -190..208 mm and reach the front edge (x 249 mm); reach 0-60 mm ball centre height above the head lift (head roller at 95 mm, head down); body front without the head 115 mm (INT_centrador); capacity = 6 basket + 12 tower REF balls. Port DC1 is an assumption (TBD).

mechanisms.source: v22 CAD parts and motors. Ports are assumptions (TBD with the electrical team); speeds marked estimate.

elevator.note: carriage travel from the two v22 STEP files; DC37 50 rpm x 90T GT2 pulley (180 mm/rev) = 150 mm/s

intake_lift.note: INT_UR head on 428 mm rails (z 102-530 mm, 40 mm slides): ~380 mm travel; DC25 ~200 rpm x 16 mm lead (T8x16) = 53 mm/s, estimate

gripper_jaw.note: GR_ lead-screw jaw: closure from the 138 mm open gap (v22 CAD); positive power closes. Port and speed are assumptions

intake_rollers.note: INT_motor_DC37_200rpm (same port as the intake model)

shooter.note: brushless friction wheels, estimate; the 3D view caps the displayed speed

intake_head.note: INT_UR_motor_DC25_giro_interno: head fingered roller on its own motor (port assumed). With DC1 off it drags balls / props out (pull mode)

ball_path.source: v22 CAD reference balls (REF_pelota_canasta / _torre) as storage slots; waypoints read off the intake, tower (TW_), elbow and basket (CN_) parts; speeds and launch values are estimates
ball_path.body_bands_note: robot outline (without the intake head) per height band from the v22 CAD, carriage down; used for collisions with field structures

gripper.source: v22 CAD: jaws GR_mordaza_fija / _movil at CAD x 207-250 mm, y -158..-20 mm (138 mm gap), z 14-157 mm with the carriage down

own_half.note: two robots per alliance: this robot (Red Start 1) plays y <= 1527.5 mm, the partner the upper half (team decision 2026-10-31)

team_flag.source: v22 CAD con_mastil_y_bandera_carro_arriba: REF_bandera spans CAD y -214..86 mm (robot x), CAD x 190-198 mm (robot y -194), top 1128 mm with the carriage up 358 mm -> 770 mm with it down; FLAG_mastil at robot (x -64, y -64..-68 CAD x 181)
team_flag.override_note: design proposal (simulated): flag rod on the LEFT side (launcher side, y +194 mm) reaching the front edge of the projection (249 mm). Facing the back wall, the chassis front must stay at x >= 312 mm (pin area x < 195 mm, 405 mm high) while the rod reaches the pole (x 0-120 mm, 961 mm high): a 37 mm window, intake head up (>= 364 mm) over the pin area. With the CAD mast (right side, front 86 mm) the cone post (x 180-220, y 868-908) keeps the rod >= 150 mm short. Set both overrides to null for the CAD mast
